# Top-level tests whose wall time exceeds the 1-minute per-test budget as
# measured by `testbudget check` in scripts/postmerge_full.sh (go test -p=8
# under the post-merge scope: GOMAXPROCS=2, GOMEMLIMIT=1536MiB). SHRINK-ONLY:
# rows are deleted when the test is fixed, never added; the exact
# package/test pairs are pinned by wallExceptionPins in
# wall_exceptions_test.go. A new offender is split into chunk tests, not
# pinned. Columns: package, test, wall_s (rounded up). The peak-RSS twin is
# rss_exceptions.txt.
#
# `!unseeded` below means no whole-suite run has populated this list yet (a
# seat may not run one). While it is present `testbudget check` still names
# every offender, with its measured numbers and a ready-to-paste row, but does
# not fail the batch. The first post-merge batch after this landed prints them;
# paste them here, add their pins, and delete the marker line. From then on a
# test over budget that is not listed here fails post-merge.
!unseeded
